name.text: Surface area of a storage box, made of a hemisphere and a cylinder

questiontext.text:
A designer is creating a decorative storage container by joining a hemisphere to the top of a cylinder, as shown below.

[[jsxgraph]] const brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-10, 10, 10, -12], axis: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, keepAspectRatio: true }); const r = 4; // schematic radius const h = 8; // schematic cylinder height const k = 0.30; // ellipse squash factor // ---------- Cylinder ---------- // Cylinder sides const L1 = brd.create('point', [-r,-h], {visible:false}); const L2 = brd.create('point', [-r,0], {visible:false}); const R1 = brd.create('point', [ r,-h], {visible:false}); const R2 = brd.create('point', [ r,0], {visible:false}); brd.create('segment',[L1,L2],{ strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2 }); brd.create('segment',[R1,R2],{ strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2 }); // Bottom ellipse brd.create('curve',[ t => r*Math.cos(t), t => -h + k*r*Math.sin(t), 0,2*Math.PI ],{ strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:1.5 }); // Top join ellipse (visible front) brd.create('curve',[ t => r*Math.cos(t), t => k*r*Math.sin(t), 0,Math.PI ],{ strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:1.5 }); // Top join ellipse (hidden back) brd.create('curve',[ t => r*Math.cos(t), t => k*r*Math.sin(t), Math.PI,2*Math.PI ],{ strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:1, dash:2 }); // ---------- Hemisphere ---------- // Hemisphere dome brd.create('curve',[ t => r*Math.cos(t), t => r*Math.sin(t), 0,Math.PI ],{ strokeColor:'#1f3c88', strokeWidth:2, fillColor:'#90caf9', fillOpacity:0.5 }); // ---------- Dimension lines ---------- // Radius const O = brd.create('point',[0,-h],{visible:false}); const Rad = brd.create('point',[r,-h],{visible:false}); brd.create('segment',[O,Rad],{ dash:2 }); brd.create('text',[ r/2, -h-1, '{#radius#} cm' ]); // Height const H1 = brd.create('point',[-6,0],{visible:false}); const H2 = brd.create('point',[-6,-h],{visible:false}); brd.create('segment',[H1,H2],{ strokeWidth:1, dash:2 }); brd.create('text',[ -8, -h/2, '{#height#} cm' ]); [[/jsxgraph]]

The cylinder has:

  • radius {@radius@} cm
  • height {@height@} cm

Calculate the total external surface area of the container. Use \(\pi=\frac{22}{7}\).

[[input:ans1]]\(\text{cm}^2\) [[feedback:prt1]]

[[validation:ans1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Solution

To calculate the total external surface area of the composite solid, identify only the surfaces that are exposed.

  • Curved surface area of the cylinder: \[ 2\pi rh \]
  • Curved surface area of the hemisphere: \[ 2\pi r^2 \]
  • Circular base of the cylinder: \[ \pi r^2 \]

The circular face where the hemisphere joins the cylinder is inside the solid and is not part of the external surface area.

Therefore,

\[ \begin{aligned} \text{Total Surface Area} &=2\pi rh+2\pi r^2+\pi r^2\\ &=2\pi rh+3\pi r^2. \end{aligned} \]

Substituting \[ r={@radius@}\text{ cm},\qquad h={@height@}\text{ cm} \] gives \[ 2\times\frac{22}{7}\times {@radius@}\times {@height@} + 3\times\frac{22}{7}\times {@radius@}^2 = {@Total_surface_area@}\text{ cm}^2. \]
